# Kaycee Brock

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/08/Brock-square-enhanced.png)

- Regarding student discipline, [Brock said](https://web.archive.org/web/20260610045908/https:/civicatlanta.org/voteatl/2025-school-board-candidate-responses#jennifer-mcdonald) she would “prioritize alternatives to suspension - such as restorative circles, peer mediation, and increased access to counselors - so that discipline is about growth, not exclusion.”
- Regarding LGBT students, [Brock said](https://web.archive.org/web/20260610045908/https:/civicatlanta.org/voteatl/2025-school-board-candidate-responses#jennifer-mcdonald), “LGBTQ+ students deserve to learn in environments where they are affirmed.” Brock also advocates for “training for staff on affirming practices and LGBTQ+ issues.”
